title: Monsoon Kissed American Pasta Lasagna
description: A rich, ovo-vegetarian lasagna dish infused with the essence of Vin Santo, served in a traditional tandoor clay pot. This recipe celebrates the fusion of East and West with a creamy pasta-water emulsion and a satisfying crumbly texture.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375°F (190°C).
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt. Mix well to combine.
Add the bechamel sauce to the ricotta mixture and stir until smooth.
In a separate bowl, combine the chopped basil and cooked lasagna noodles.
In the preheated tandoor clay pot, create a thin layer of the pasta-water emulsion on the bottom.
Spread half of the lasagna noodles on top of the emulsion.
Spread half of the ricotta-bechamel mixture over the noodles.
Sprinkle half of the shredded mozzarella cheese over the ricotta-bechamel mixture.
Repeat the layers: noodles, pasta-water emulsion, ricotta-bechamel mixture, and mozzarella cheese.
Top the final layer of mozzarella cheese with the Tandoori spice blend.
Cover the tandoor clay pot with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
